{{Short description|Norwegian physicist (1933–2022)}}
'''Per Christian Møller Hemmer''' (14 May 1933 – 5 February 2022<ref>[https://snl.no/Per_Christian_Hemmer Per Christian Hemmer] {{in lang|no}}</ref>) was a Norwegian physicist.

He was born in [[Tromøy Municipality]] as a son of Alv Kristiansen and Hilda Møller. He married Ellen Vorvik in 1955.<ref name=hvem>{{cite encyclopedia|year=1973|title=Hemmer, Per C.|encyclopedia=[[Hvem er hvem?]]|editor=Steenstrup, Bjørn|publisher=Aschehoug|location=Oslo|url=https://runeberg.org/hvemerhvem/1973/0234.html|pages=234–235|language=Norwegian|access-date=27 February 2011}}</ref>

He became a student in 1951 and graduated from the [[Norwegian Institute of Technology]] in 1956. He took the [[dr.techn.|doctorate]] already in 1959, and was a [[research fellow]] at the [[University of Copenhagen]] from 1959 and the [[Rockefeller University]] from 1961. He led a project in Oslo between 1963 and 1965, was appointed as [[docent]] at the Norwegian Institute of Technology in 1969 and promoted to professor in [[theoretical physics]] in 1969. He was a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] from 1966 and the [[Norwegian Academy of Technological Sciences]] from 1967.<ref name=hvem/> He was vice president of the [[International Union of Pure and Applied Physics]] from 1984 to 1990.<ref name=snl>{{cite encyclopedia|year=|title=Per Christian Hemmer|encyclopedia=[[Store norske leksikon]] |publisher=Kunnskapsforlaget |location=Oslo |url=http://www.snl.no/Per_Christian_Hemmer |language=Norwegian |accessdate=27 February 2011 }}</ref> He has also contributed to the use of Norwegian language in university physics education, by writing introductory text books in both thermal physics and quantum mechanics that are used at NTNU and elsewhere.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://sittapir.sit.no/produkt/9788251920285/kvantemekanikk |title=Kvantemekanikk - SiT |accessdate=2011-05-21 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20110827090959/http://sittapir.sit.no/produkt/9788251920285/kvantemekanikk |archivedate=2011-08-27 }}</ref>
